newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO in $330 mln Venezuelan steel JV.
newsitem.headline: POSCO in $330 mln Venezuelan steel JV.

text.p: South Korea's Pohang Iron and Steel Co (POSCO) has signed a $330 million joint venture contract to build a hot briquetted iron plant in Venezuela, the company said in a statement.
POSCO and its subsidiaries will hold a 60 percent stake in the venture, POSCO Venezuela CA, the statement said on Tuesday.
Construction of the factory will begin in April and is expected to be completed in the first half of 1999. It is likely to have an annual production capacity of 1.5 million tonnes.

Other partners in the joint venture are Dongbu USA and Hyundai Corp, with a combined 15 percent stake, Venezuela's Ferrominera, with a 10 percent stake, U.S.-based Raytheon Co, 10 percent, and Mexico's Hylsa, five percent.
